Details that still need verification

  • Internal street names, tiny symbols and unlabeled facilities
  • Exact boundaries, distances and individual parking extents
  • Bridge names, widths, availability and direction rules
  • Official capacity, entry/exit gates and emergency access
  • Current ground conditions beyond the 2025 source

Use the satellite dates and low-confidence filter to inspect candidates. Add planned facilities with “Place marker”. The 10 m imagery cannot establish safe walking widths or operating status.
